mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.name, c.credit, c.hours, c.teacher_id AS teacherId, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, c.semester, c.year, c.max_students AS maxStudents, c.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.classroom, c.max_credits AS maxCredits, c.status, c.description, c.study_nature AS studyNature, c.textbook, c.external_selection AS externalSelection, c.remark, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(c.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT id, course_no FROM course WHERE course_no IN
#{courseNo}
